results.limitations: Sender-local monotonic time. ACK latency includes forwarding, hashing and browser scheduling. Fault timing is an application-level command, not physical Wi-Fi failure. Receiver byte evidence is reported by its authenticated overlay receipt; remote wall clocks are not subtracted.
